question: For each course material detail in the Chemistry department, provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the subject title, the offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, and only include results where the offering department name is 'Chemistry'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
column_mapping: {"course material detail": ["TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY", "TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE", "TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID", "TIP_DETAIL.ISBN", "TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY"], "material status key": ["TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY"], "term code": ["TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE"], "subject ID": ["TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID"], "ISBN": ["TIP_DETAIL.ISBN"], "material key": ["TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY"], "course number description": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC"], "subject title": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE"], "offering department name": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME"], "maximum number of enrolled students": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS"], "Chemistry department": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME"]}
domain_knowledge: ["\"Chemistry\" is predicated by \"TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'\"", "\"Course 5\" is predicated by \"TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'\""]

expected.sql: SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
